table ip nat {
	chain prerouting {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		tcp dport 80 redirect to :8000-8010
		tcp dport 81 redirect to :8000-8010 random
		tcp dport 82 redirect to :8000-8010 fully-random
		tcp dport 83 dnat to 203.0.113.10:8200-8210 persistent
		tcp dport 84 dnat to 203.0.113.10:8200-8210 random,persistent
		tcp dport 85 dnat to 203.0.113.10-203.0.113.12
		tcp dport 86 dnat to 203.0.113.10-203.0.113.12:8300-8310
		udp dport 53 redirect to :5300-5310
	}
}
table ip6 nat {
	chain prerouting {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		tcp dport 80 dnat to [2001:db8:1::10]:8000-8010
		tcp dport 81 dnat to 2001:db8:1::10-2001:db8:1::12
	}
}
